item.title: Tony Dayimane Drops “Where Would I Be” Visuals Following EP Release
item.description: Tony Dayimane has released the visualiser for “Where Would I Be,” the fifth track from his EP Girls & MP3’s, which dropped on 13 February. The record sees him unpacking patterns from past relationships, addressing what he describes as “narcissistic behaviour” and a constant need to be in control.
